contributions.claim: WHO reports a Hondius crew member is infected with hantavirus after the ship docked in Rotterdam.
contributions.uncertainty: No timing of infection, test method or exact relation to prior tested cohort supplied.

contributions.claim: Later 'turns out infected after all' account qualifies the earlier all-negative Hondius report.
contributions.attribution: NU.nl successive reports; later WHO attribution
contributions.uncertainty: May reflect new result or earlier false negative; no explicit publisher correction or proof earlier statement was false at the time.

relations.reason: Same named ship and Rotterdam arrival; later positive is material qualification.

delta_expectations.reason: Positive crew result materially changes all-negative picture without rewriting frozen prior label.

questions.claim: How does the crew member's positive result relate to the earlier all-negative testing report?

ambiguity_notes: Do not assert onward transmission or count as newly acquired infection; sources say newly identified case. Publication-order availability unknown.
